dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Sure. Something new to share with me?

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: You know, I've heard a lot of stories about you since arriving in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: For example, the time that you helped the knights from Mondstadt to defeat a dragon.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: And the time that you teamed up with the adepti in Liyue to defeat an ancient god from the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Gods and dragons... Can't believe they really exist here.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: But whatever the crisis may be, you always step forward and join up with those who want to fight back, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: It's because of people like you that both cities were able to survive and prevail.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I only made a small contribution...

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: If that's what you call a small contribution, I think it might take saving the whole world to count as a major one.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Seriously, though, if the world ever does need saving, bring me with you.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: I've saved a world once before. I might be able to give you some pointers.

choices.text: Like "Never save the world on an empty stomach"?

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Ha, yeah, that's right. Trying to save the world when you can't stop thinking about food is pretty tough... The end of the world deserves your full, undivided attention.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Seriously, though. Trying to save the world is exhausting, especially when you're not even sure who's trying to end it.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: The worst part is, once you find out who's responsible, they're always so full of themselves, making out like you're the one in the wrong.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: You can't reason with them. It always comes down to a fight. I guess that's just the way it is.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Maybe. But sometimes you need to take the world on your shoulders in order to save it.
